title_en: Technology and Engineering (5/20): Robot Arms in the Factory
note_en: 把 (bǎ) moves the object in front of the verb when the sentence is about what happens to that object: 把一个个零件准确地安装到位 "install each part precisely in place." English keeps the object after the verb, but a 把 sentence needs the verb to be followed by a result or destination, here 到位 "into position."
